content.text: This test isn't flaky — it's catching a real connection leak (thread-local connections aren't released after `with db:` transactions end on worker threads). Deleting or skipping it would hide that bug rather than fix it, so I'm going to look at the actual cause first rather than just silence the test.

content.text: Found the real bug: `Database.commit()`/`rollback()` never remove the connection from `self.connections` when a thread's outermost transaction ends, so every thread that ever calls `with db:` leaks a connection entry that's never cleaned up. Fixing that properly rather than deleting the test.
